tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground, label boxes laid over imagery, signal-card fills. The only ground besides `inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, hairlines, active underlines and the outlined search word, on `paper` (21:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: News, dates, timeline items and their frames, and nothing else. On `paper` it is 4.0:1 in Paper and 5.25:1 in Inverted, so set it bold at 19px or larger; never body copy.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: One-pixel text halo behind `signal` text that sits on the halftone texture or on imagery.

tokens.name: document
tokens.usage: Links that download a file (paper PDF, CV, slides), on `paper`: 5.28:1 in Paper, 8.05:1 in Inverted.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Ground of the related-work footer and other inverted bands: always the opposite of `paper`.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text, captions and rotated labels on `inverse` (21:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines of the metadata table and the underline of the search field, on `paper`.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Dots of the halftone texture behind external-coverage cards.

tokens.name: on-dark-image
tokens.usage: Nav words and their outline over imagery whose top band is dark; check 4.5:1 against that band.

tokens.name: on-light-image
tokens.usage: Nav words and their outline over imagery whose top band is light; check 4.5:1 against that band.

styles.name: t-supergraphic
styles.usage: Nav words only, uppercase. 94px is the 1440px reference: the nav fits the words to the full row (about 6.5vw for four words).

styles.name: t-headline
styles.usage: Uppercase label box on a feature plate. Scales at 3.5vw, 4.5vw on phones.

styles.name: t-display
styles.sample: A miniaturized wireless platform for electrochemical sensing
styles.usage: Project titles in the index, page headings, news headlines, timeline years.

styles.name: t-section
styles.usage: Section list under the nav, uppercase. Scales at 2.3vw; 19px on phones.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Electrochemical sensors can read proteins, ions and metabolites, but the instruments that drive them sit on lab benches.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and running text, inside the 788px measure.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Uppercase controls: filter toggles, the phone section menu.

styles.name: t-date
styles.usage: Dates in `signal`; group labels (Ongoing, Proposals) in `ink`.

styles.name: t-meta
styles.usage: Metadata table rows and the view switch; labels uppercase.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Captions under related-work thumbnails; names in credits.

styles.name: t-caption-strong
styles.usage: Rotated row labels in the related-work footer, uppercase.

styles.name: t-micro
styles.usage: Footnotes and the legal line only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Nudge between a date and its headline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Metadata label inset; gap above a source line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside a framed signal card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page margin on phones; paragraph spacing; gallery row gap; nav offset from the top.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between index rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop; space above page headings and around the metadata table.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of the related-work footer.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the footer; space between timeline years.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter of the 12-column grid (22px inside the 950px container).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of index rows, galleries, timelines and related rows.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Text column: 10 of 12 columns, centered in the container.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every corner. The system has no rounded shapes.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Metadata rows and the table's top rule.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The boxed section menu on phones.

tokens.name: border-view
tokens.usage: Underline of the selected view (LIST, GRID).

tokens.name: border-active
tokens.usage: Underline of the current section; frame of a signal card.

tokens.name: border-search
tokens.usage: Underline of the search field.

tokens.name: tracking-display
tokens.usage: Every bold display size: nav, labels, titles, dates.

tokens.name: tracking-search
tokens.usage: The search field only.

tokens.name: image-index
tokens.usage: Filter on every image in index rows and related rows; color returns on hover and keyboard focus.

tokens.name: image-feature
tokens.usage: Feature plates and project galleries stay in full color.

tokens.name: ratio-index
tokens.usage: Index-row thumbnails and feature plates.

tokens.name: ratio-plate
tokens.usage: Gallery plates and related-work thumbnails.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: The fixed supergraphic nav, above every plate and card.
